title: The Viksit Bharat—Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB—G RAM G (विकसित भारत—जी राम जी) Act, 2025
source_id: Act of 2025 (LDH record id IN_IndiaCode_2025-36 suggests Act No. 36 of 2025; not confirmed)
verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode search hit gives the title, the date 2025-12-20 and handle 22478; s.1 provides for commencement by notification. A PIB release (PRID 2259712), seen only in web search results, says the Act is in force from 1 July 2026 and that MGNREGA 2005 stands repealed from that date. The Gazette notification was not read.
notes: Rural employment guarantee. It replaces the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005, if the 1 July 2026 commencement is confirmed. Check the Act number and commencement notification when India Code is reachable.
